mapper.select: SELECT version_id, component_id, version, release_date, changelog, is_current, detect_source, create_time FROM open_component_version WHERE component_id = #{componentId} ORDER BY is_current DESC, release_date DESC, version_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM open_component_version WHERE component_id = #{componentId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO open_component_version (component_id, version, release_date, changelog, is_current, detect_source) VALUES (#{componentId}, #{version}, #{releaseDate}, #{changelog}, IFNULL(#{isCurrent}, 0), IFNULL(#{detectSource}, 'API'))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM open_component_version WHERE component_id = #{componentId} AND detect_source = 'API' AND is_current = 0
